[SWS_ANM_00077]
⌈
If
NmPnEnabled
is
TRUE
, the getter for the NetworkHandle shall
provide the (aggregated) request state of the PNs instead of mirroring the last received
Partial Network information.
⌋
(RS_Nm_00150)
Note: PnResetTime specified in [3] shall be configured by
NmPnResetTime
. Note:
NmPnResetTime
shall be configured to a value greater than
NmMsgCycleTime
.
7.8.3 Tx Handling of NM messages
Note:
NmPnEnabled
enable/disable the PNI transmission as specified in chapter "Han-
dling of Tx NM messages" of [3].
Note: The usage of the CBV is mandatory in case Partial Networking is used. This has
to be ensured by configuration in the respective platform.
7.8.4 NM message Filter Algorithm
